Problem: Qwen model runs locally; team lead should not install model/Ollama.
Planned Solution: Host model remotely; keep model access behind FastAPI.
Technical Implementation: Containerize model service; configure OLLAMA_HOST/model endpoint; validate suitable free/demo host.

Problem: Localhost application is not accessible externally.
Technical Implementation: Serve production frontend from FastAPI; deploy/tunnel FastAPI securely.

Problem: Strong model for every request can increase latency/resource usage.
Planned Solution: Classify and route requests by complexity.
Technical Implementation: Classifier → fast model for suitable requests → Qwen for complex requests; add escalation.

Problem: Model may not know correct tables, columns, relationships or terminology.
Planned Solution: Use controlled schema and business knowledge.
Technical Implementation: Schema metadata + business dictionary + ChromaDB/RAG retrieval.

Problem: Follow-ups may lose previous context.
Planned Solution: Maintain structured session context and entity references.
Technical Implementation: Store location, role, metric, time and result references per session.

Problem: Users may access simultaneously and contexts must not mix.
Planned Solution: Isolate sessions and handle concurrent requests.
Technical Implementation: user_id + session_id + request_id; async FastAPI; Redis; DB pooling; limits/queue.

Problem: Some users may not want conversations stored.
Planned Solution: Provide normal, temporary/private and no-memory modes.
Technical Implementation: Separate active context from persistent history; define retention for cache/logs/history.

Problem: Relative dates and IST/UTC boundaries can be misinterpreted.
Technical Implementation: Date/timezone resolver before SQL generation.

Problem: Average, NULL, zero, historical/current balance can differ by business rule.
Planned Solution: Define approved metric logic outside the LLM where possible.
Technical Implementation: Metric dictionary + deterministic rules + source selection.

Problem: Distributor/retailer/wholesaler/mechanic relationships can be ambiguous.
Technical Implementation: Role resolver + FK/join graph + join validation.

Problem: LLM may generate wrong SQL.
Planned Solution: Generate SQL using retrieved schema/business context.
Technical Implementation: Prompt/model receives controlled context; strong model generates SQL/plan.

Problem: Valid SQL syntax can still be unsafe/incorrect.
Technical Implementation: sqlglot/AST parsing; check tables, columns, joins and operations.

Problem: Model could request restricted columns or operations.
Technical Implementation: Column blacklist, permissions, read-only rules and deterministic checks.

Problem: Valid queries can still be too expensive.
Technical Implementation: EXPLAIN/cost checks + thresholds; reject/request filters.

Problem: Many users can exhaust MySQL connections.
Technical Implementation: SQLAlchemy pool, limits, timeouts and health checks.

Problem: Database changes can make AI knowledge stale.
Technical Implementation: Schema Inspector/diff; invalidate affected knowledge; create new knowledge version.

Problem: Model/API/DB can fail or timeout.
Technical Implementation: Timeouts, health checks, bounded retries and graceful errors.

Problem: Updates can interrupt users or introduce regressions.
Technical Implementation: Development → testing → staging → warm new version → gradual traffic → monitor → rollback if needed.

Problem: New schema/business knowledge may conflict with current version.
Planned Solution: Version and validate knowledge before activation.
Technical Implementation: knowledge_v1/v2; test retrieval and SQL scenarios before switching.

Problem: Problems are difficult to diagnose without visibility.
Technical Implementation: Structured logs, health endpoints, latency/error metrics, model availability checks.

Problem: One-user success does not prove multi-user capacity.
Technical Implementation: Run 2/5/10+ concurrent-user tests; record latency, queue time, DB connections and errors.

Problem: Team lead needs to test without installing model.
Technical Implementation: FastAPI + production frontend + accessible model + DB + HTTPS; verify externally.
Expected Outcome: Team lead can test from browser.
